rules.title: CAPTCHA verification response not checked for hostname/action
rules.note: Also check `hostname` (and `action` for reCAPTCHA v3 / Turnstile) so tokens solved on another site, or for another form, are rejected.

rules.title: Paid AI/media API called with no usage check nearby
rules.note: Free accounts (and anonymous visitors) can run up your bill. Enforce a per-user and per-IP quota on the server before calling the provider.

rules.title: Anonymous sign-in enabled
rules.note: Each anonymous session is a new free user. Cap them per IP/device, add CAPTCHA, and keep is_anonymous users out of costly features in RLS/server checks.

rules.title: Premium content gated only in the UI
rules.note: Fine for hiding buttons. A finding when the premium data was already sent to the browser (props, API response, RSC payload) and is only hidden.

rules.title: Referral reward granted without a qualifying event
rules.note: Rewarding the sign-up itself invites self-referral farms. Reward after a verified, paying or active referee, once per device/payment method.

rules.title: User-supplied link rendered without rel="nofollow ugc"
rules.note: Followed links on public profiles attract SEO spam accounts. Add rel="nofollow ugc noopener" and consider delaying links for new accounts.

rules.title: Bot detection based on the User-Agent string
rules.note: The User-Agent is set by the client; abusive scripts change it. Use rate limits, CAPTCHA/Turnstile or a bot-management service for valuable endpoints.
